base.subject: Mimi
base.story: 小猫 Mimi 的频道首支视频，认真准备自我介绍，却接连翻车：尾巴扫走提词卡、碰倒水杯，水滴打湿粉色蝴蝶结和金色铃铛，最后破功卖萌求订阅。
keyPoints: 一本正经与慌张的反差

content.xhsTitle: 第一次自我介绍就社死😭
content.xhsDesc:
谁懂啊！给频道录第一条自我介绍，本来准备得可认真了…
结果尾巴一扫，把提词卡直接扫飞了😭
然后爪子一挥，杯子翻倒，水全溅到胸前的蝴蝶结和铃铛上…
最后干脆摆烂：自我介绍失败，但欢迎订阅！
姐妹们第一次录视频也这么灾难吗？

content.youtubeTitle: My FIRST introduction… It went horribly wrong 😹 | Mimi
content.youtubeDesc:
Hi everyone! This is Mimi's very first video on this channel 😺
I tried my best to make a proper self-introduction… but everything went wrong.
I lost my script, knocked over a cup, and got my bow and bell all wet!
Hope this silly little awkward debut can make you smile.
If you like my clumsy moments, please hit subscribe and stay tuned for more fun cat content!
